# Commit message conventions

- Base the message on the actual changes.
- Start with a concise, one-line summary in imperative mood.
- Follow existing repository conventions.
- Use a conventional commit prefix when appropriate.
- Explain motivation and implementation details in the body when useful.
- Mention changed files only when this adds meaningful context.
- Do not invent requirements, motivations, or behavior.
- Use correct grammar and punctuation.
